meta.title: Soups & Stews: a dish tree drawn from culinary knowledge
meta.by: Claude, from culinary knowledge. Not DPI factory output; not yet critiqued or approved.
meta.leaf_rule: A leaf is one dish: the set of recipes a cook would accept as the same thing. A change of method or richness (roasted, creamy, slow cooker) is a variant of a leaf, not a new leaf.

Avgolemono Soup: The dish is Avgolemono; 'soup' is redundant.
Butternut Squash Soup: 'Roasted' is a variant, not a leaf.
Chicken Noodle Soup: Turkey Noodle and Creamy Chicken Noodle are variants.
Chili: 'Chili' becomes the group; the beef dish takes its full name.
Greek Chickpea Soup (Ρεβιθόσουπα): Greek Chickpea Soup kept as an alias.
Hot and Sour Soup: Miso Soup recipes lean on it today; Miso Soup is its own leaf.
Hungarian Goulash: American Goulash is a macaroni skillet dish and leaves the chapter.
Lentil Soup: Its alias 'Red Lentil Soup' is a different dish (cooked down smooth) and becomes a leaf.
Matzoh Ball Soup: A spelling of the same dish; becomes an alias.
New England Clam Chowder: Unqualified 'Clam Chowder' is an alias here; Manhattan is a separate leaf.
Niu Rou Mian: Niu Rou Mian kept as an alias.
Pho: Beef and chicken pho are different broths; a cook wants one or the other.
Portuguese Kale Soup: Caldo Verde is a different, thinner soup and gets its own leaf.
Potato Soup: Potato Leek Soup is a separate leaf; Baked Potato Soup is an alias.
Pozole: Rojo, verde and blanco are variants.
Ramen: Shoyu Ramen + Shio Ramen + Miso Ramen + Tonkotsu Ramen + Tantanmen
'Ramen' is a group; cooks choose by broth.
Shorabet Adas: Duplicate pair; both become aliases of Red Lentil Soup.
Shorabet Adas (Lentil Soup): Duplicate pair; both become aliases of Red Lentil Soup.
Shrimp and Corn Chowder: Arguable: could be a variant of Corn Chowder.
Shrimp Gumbo: Shrimp is one seafood gumbo; Chicken and Sausage Gumbo is the missing sibling.
Stufato di Pesce: A generic Italian phrase for fish stew; Cioppino recipes lean on it and get their own leaf.
Thai Red Curry: A curry eaten over rice, not a soup or stew course. Tom Kha Gai and Massaman lean on it today.
Tomato Soup: 'Roasted' is a variant. Tom Yum recipes lean on it today by name accident.
Tortilla Soup: Taco Soup is a different dish and gets a leaf.
Turkey Chili: Arguable: could be a variant of Chili con Carne.
Tuscan White Bean Soup: Zuppa Toscana and Ribollita lean on it today; both are separate leaves.
Vegetable Soup: The largest pile of weak leaners (32): a catch-all today.
